name: WEAM – Product Manager for WooCommerce
author: weam4woo

sections.description:
THE PRODUCT MANAGER THAT REPLACES 3-4 WOOCOMMERCE PLUGINS

WEAM combines product editing, health checks, variation management, pricing tools, and attribute configuration into one integrated plugin. Stop stitching together separate tools — get everything in one place.

Product Editor

  • Visual Attribute Cards: Replace WooCommerce’s cramped attribute interface with clean, expandable cards. See all values at a glance.
  • Multiple Input Types: Choose checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, or multi-select per attribute.
  • Type-to-Filter Search: Find any value instantly, even with thousands of terms.
  • Quick Add Values: Type cotton | wool | silk and WEAM creates all three at once. No page reloads.
  • Bulk Operations: Select all, select none, shift+click range selection, and bulk delete with batched processing.
  • Cost Price Field: Track cost prices directly in the product editor. No extra plugin needed.

Product Health

  • 8 Live Checks: Automatically checks every product for missing images, empty descriptions, missing SKUs, pricing errors, stock issues, missing categories, gallery problems, and duplicate SKUs.
  • Full Catalog Scanner [Pro]: Batch scan across 6 categories (Products, Fields, SEO, Duplicates, Variants, Channels) with scheduled scans, CSV export, and email reports.

Variation Editor

  • Improved Variation Interface: Inline editing, pagination, and a cleaner layout than WooCommerce default. Included free.
  • Bulk Variation Actions [Pro]: Bulk pricing, image management, and preset configurations.

Product Attributes

  • Per-Attribute Settings: Configure each attribute with its own input type, layout, sorting, search behavior, and help text.
  • Attribute Values Dashboard: View usage statistics per value, safely identify and delete unused terms.
  • Empty Field Protection: Prevents WooCommerce from silently removing empty attributes on save.

Product Pricing [Pro]

  • Pricing Dashboard: Dedicated pricing table with sidebar filters, category/brand breakdown, and margin calculations.
  • Bulk Price Actions [Pro]: Apply price changes, sale prices, cost prices, and VAT across multiple products at once.
  • Price Scheduling [Pro]: Schedule future price changes with Action Scheduler integration.
  • Price Alerts [Pro]: 10 automated pricing health checks with trend tracking and email reports.

Store Protection

  • Delete Protection: Simple confirmation with impact preview for free users.
  • Advanced Protection [Pro]: PIN verification (shop-wide or personal), backup browser, and role-based delete permissions.
  • Audit Trail [Pro]: Track all product changes with a 14-day activity chart, user breakdown, and filtered history.

More Pro Features

  • Attribute Icons [Pro]: Turn attribute values into visual icons on product pages. 4-step wizard with Pixabay search, shape customization, and shortcodes.
  • Smart Attributes [Pro]: 15 pre-built attribute presets (colors, sizes, materials) for fast store setup.
  • SKU Automator [Pro]: Generate consistent SKU patterns across products and variations.
  • AI Anomaly Detection [Pro]: Scan your catalog for data quality issues and inconsistent values.
  • Import/Export [Pro]: Backup and restore attribute configurations and pricing data.
  • Role-Based Permissions [Pro]: Control which user roles can delete values and manage attributes.

Why store owners choose WEAM

  • Less plugins — One install replaces your attribute editor, variation manager, product health checker, and cost tracker
  • Less clicking — Quick Add, bulk operations, and inline editing save hours per week
  • Less mistakes — Product Health catches missing data before your customers do
  • Less risk — Delete Protection and Audit Trail prevent accidents and track changes

Documentation & Support

  • Features — Complete feature breakdown with screenshots
  • FAQ — Common questions answered
  • Pricing — Free and Pro plans
  • Support — Get help

External services

This plugin optionally connects to the Pixabay API to search for royalty-free images when setting up attribute icons (Pro feature). This feature requires a free Pixabay API key that the user provides in the plugin settings.

Pixabay image search

  • What it does: Searches the Pixabay image library for icons to use as attribute swatches.
  • When data is sent: Only when the admin actively searches for images in the Attribute Icons settings. No data is sent automatically or in the background.
  • What data is sent: The search query (text), image type filter, and the user’s API key.
  • Service provider: Pixabay (pixabay.com)
  • Terms of service: https://pixabay.com/service/terms/
  • Privacy policy: https://pixabay.com/service/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/weam4woo/ or install through the WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → WEAM to configure your settings
  4. Edit any product — WEAM automatically enhances the Attributes tab

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.faq:
Can WEAM replace multiple WooCommerce plugins?

Yes. WEAM combines product attribute editing, variation management, product health checks, cost price tracking, and delete protection into one plugin. Most stores can remove 2-4 separate plugins after installing WEAM.

Does WEAM check my products for errors?

Yes. Product Health runs 8 live checks on every product: missing images, empty descriptions, missing SKUs, pricing errors, stock issues, missing categories, gallery problems, and duplicate SKUs. Pro adds a full catalog scanner with 6 specialized tabs and scheduled scans.

Can I edit WooCommerce variations faster with WEAM?

Yes. The Variation Editor provides inline editing, pagination, and a cleaner layout than the default WooCommerce variation interface. This feature is included free.

Does WEAM track cost prices and margins?

Yes. A cost price field is built into the product editor for free. Pro adds cost price scheduling, margin warnings, and automated price alerts.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WEAM extends WooCommerce’s product editing functionality. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Will this work with my theme?

WEAM works in the WordPress admin area and does not affect your storefront appearance. It is compatible with any theme that supports WooCommerce. The only frontend feature is Attribute Icons (Pro), which displays visual icons on product pages via shortcode.

Does it support variable products?

Yes. WEAM fully supports simple and variable products. The built-in Variation Editor makes variation management significantly faster than the default WooCommerce interface.

What happens to my data if I deactivate the plugin?

Nothing. WEAM uses standard WooCommerce data storage. Your product data, attributes, and variations remain unchanged. Deactivating returns you to the default WooCommerce interface.

Is it compatible with WPML and Polylang?

Yes. WEAM works with standard WooCommerce attributes, which are fully supported by WPML, Polylang, and other translation plugins.

Where can I get support?

Free users can use the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users get priority support at weam.nl/support/.
sections.changelog:
2.2.3.3

  • Fix: Comma decimal normalization on all price save paths (auto-save, VE direct edit, propagate)

2.2.3.2

  • Fix: Additional comma decimal parsing on direct price input, blur formatter, and price warnings

2.2.3.1

  • Fix: “Save to all variants” now works in Free build (AJAX handler was incorrectly Pro-gated)
  • Fix: Orphan variation delete now works in Free build
  • Fix: Price inputs with comma decimals (Dutch/EU locale) no longer rounded to .00
  • Fix: Schedule buttons hidden in Free build (scheduler is a Pro feature)

2.2.3

  • New: WEAM Dashboard — store health overview with 9 health cards, click-to-expand detail views, quick actions, and deep-linking to filtered results
  • New: Dashboard sub-cards with Products/Variations tabs for Image Issues, SKU Issues, and Price Issues
  • New: Filter bar redesign — white paper standard across all data pages, sidebar filters moved to horizontal filter bar dropdowns
  • New: Product Editor — 9 new filter options (No SKU, No description, No gallery, Uncategorized, No variations, Short title, Low stock, On backorder, No short description)
  • New: Product Editor — sidebar removed, full-width table layout
  • New: “Changed since” date filter on Product Pricing — filter by last modified date with preset options
  • New: Orphan variation detection — warns when deselecting attribute values that have active variations, with one-click cleanup
  • New: Page-load orphan check detects orphan variations automatically on product edit
  • New: Channel view — variation summary row with health stats and “Manage” scroll-to-VE
  • New: Channel view — generate variations nudge calculated server-side from actual variation attributes
  • New: Field labels turn amber when issues are detected (missing price, sale > regular, below cost, empty SKU)
  • New: “Free product” health check — detects products/variations with regular price of zero
  • New: Pricing Health sidebar — Products/Variations tabs with scope-aware deep-linking
  • New: WEAM logo in page header across all pages
  • New: Dashboard footer with Documentation, Feature Request, and License links
  • Fixed: Channel template false positive on variable products (stock checked on parent instead of per-variation)
  • Fixed: Channel save bar now lists specific missing field names instead of count
  • Fixed: Bulk actions bar centering and horizontal scroll on narrow screens
  • Fixed: Dashboard deep-links auto-enable “Show variations” for variation-scoped filters
  • Fixed: PCP compliance — escaped integer output in Dashboard page
  • Removed: Price Alert dismiss/resolve functionality — resolution now detected by scan only

2.1.12

  • Improved: CTD button design — cleaner outline buttons with intent-colored dots

2.1.11

  • Improved: Full attribute name bar clickable to expand/collapse

2.1.10

  • Improved: Redesigned attribute cards with cleaner layout
  • Improved: Variation Editor toolbar and field customization (Pro)

2.1.6

  • New: Values tab available in free version
  • Improved: WordPress.org compliance
